scope: Synthetic CPU and installed-Pi-SDK lifecycle checks; no model planning-quality or OS sandbox certification

requirements.property: Bounded goals, stable step IDs, statuses, files, constraints and evidence persist on the selected branch and reject unsupported state
Planning blocks mutating and unknown tools, unverified same-name replacements and user shell escapes; allowed shell argv are constrained
The actual SDK loads the plan tool, deduplicates unchanged active plan context and restores it after compaction
Plan restoration honors explicit context exclusions without changing the canonical persisted plan
Actual SessionManager resume and branch navigation preserve mode and clear operations without inheriting siblings
